repaired_question_bank.question: In an AI-assisted software project where a clear spec can become code quickly, what should the builder prioritize to avoid the new bottleneck?
choices: Writing more implementation code before asking users what they need.
Choosing a larger engineering team before clarifying the product goal.
Using user feedback and clear specs to decide what should be built.
Delaying prototypes until every product assumption is already fixed.
repaired_question_bank.explanation: Andrew says building has become cheaper and faster, so the harder bottleneck shifts toward deciding what to build through specs, feedback, and iteration.
